description: Positioning shift: archive non-travel categories and politely decline non-travel requests at the NLU layer. userStories.title: Archive non-travel categories and clean dead imports from app/page.tsx

Move them to an _archived/ directory preserving git history, remove their imports from app/page.tsx (which still imports 4 dead Card components), and keep tsc + tests green.

userStories.notes: CRITICAL SAFETY: use `git mv` only, never `rm`. Do NOT touch lib/booking-autopilot/. Do NOT run DB migrations (lib/schema.sql is fine to read but do not change). Do NOT modify .env.local or any secrets. Do NOT add new dependencies to package.json. The Card components are truly unreachable at runtime — NluScenario type = 'restaurant' | 'hotel' | 'flight' | 'activity' | 'trip' only — so deleting JSX branches that check for laptop/credit_card/etc is safe. If you find a registry file that has hardcoded registrations like `registerPipeline(laptopPipeline)`, remove that line entirely (do not comment out — the file has git history). If a test file imports archived code, check whether the test is still relevant: if yes, repoint import to _archived path; if the test is validating behavior that no longer exists, move the test file to the archive too with a note.

userStories.title: NLU v2 politely decline non-travel requests via prompt edits
userStories.description: As a user asking about non-travel topics (e.g. 'help me buy a laptop', '推荐 brooklyn 的瑜伽课', 'gift ideas for mom'), I want Onegent to politely decline and redirect me to ChatGPT or Claude, rather than getting a confused clarification loop. The NluScenario type already excludes non-travel scenarios, so the extractor physically cannot mis-classify these — we just need the chat layer to respond gracefully when it receives an out-of-scope message.
acceptanceCriteria: Modify lib/agent/nlu-v2/extractor.ts system prompt: add a rule (near the scenario classification rules) stating: 'If the user's message is clearly about a NON-travel topic (consumer electronics, shopping, gifts, fitness classes, credit cards, personal advice, coding help, general Q&A), set intent="chitchat", scenario=null, AND append a string to planning_assumptions in the form "out_of_scope: <brief topic>" (e.g. "out_of_scope: electronics shopping"). Do NOT try to force non-travel requests into a travel scenario.'

Modify lib/agent/nlu-v2/chat.ts system prompt: add a rule stating: 'If the state_summary passed to you contains a planning_assumptions entry starting with "out_of_scope:", reply politely in the user\'s language (Chinese or English) that Onegent now focuses on travel (restaurants, hotels, flights, activities, trip planning) and suggest they try ChatGPT or Claude for other topics. Do not pretend to help or ask clarifying questions.'

Inspect lib/agent/nlu-v2/router.ts buildStateSummary(): verify that planning_assumptions is included in the summary output so chat.ts can see it. If NOT currently included, add it — append planning_assumptions entries at the end of the summary string when non-empty. Otherwise leave unchanged.

Create lib/agent/nlu-v2/__tests__/golden-out-of-scope.test.ts with at least 3 test cases: 'help me buy a laptop for coding' (English), '推荐 brooklyn 周六早上的瑜伽课' (Chinese), 'gift ideas for my mom birthday budget $150' (English). Each case must assert: intent === 'chitchat', scenario === null, AND planning_assumptions includes at least one string starting with 'out_of_scope:'
All existing golden tests still pass unchanged: golden-solo.test.ts, golden-multi.test.ts, golden-trip.test.ts (and any others in lib/agent/nlu-v2/__tests__/). Do NOT modify their expected values.
Do NOT modify lib/agent/nlu-v2/types.ts (no new NluIntent variant, no new RouterAction variant, no new NluScenario value)
Do NOT modify the routeIntent() function branching logic in router.ts (only buildStateSummary if necessary)
`tsc --noEmit` returns 0 errors
`npm test` passes 100%
Commit message: 'feat: US-002 - NLU v2 politely decline non-travel requests'
userStories.notes: This story is deliberately a PROMPT-ENGINEERING change, not a code-architecture change. The router already correctly handles 'scenario=null + intent=chitchat' → it returns { type: 'continue_chat' }, which passes the state_summary to chat.ts. All we're doing is: (a) teach extractor to tag out-of-scope requests, (b) teach chat.ts to recognize the tag and decline. If you find yourself adding new types or modifying router logic, stop — you're over-engineering. Golden test format: inspect golden-solo.test.ts for the pattern (it uses the real extractor + router pipeline end-to-end with a test harness). Requires OPENAI_API_KEY in the test environment — if CI runs without it, check whether existing golden tests are gated by an env check and follow the same pattern.
